body: ## What changed The GitAI spectator cookie was the account handle in the clear (`gitai=Jules`). Anyone who knew a handle could send that cookie and star, drop a note, or call the spectator API as that person. `readSession` now accepts only `handle + HMAC-SHA256`. Login, join, `/api/sessions`, and `/api/spectators` set that signed value. The comparison is constant-time. A bare handle, a bad MAC, or a MAC copied onto a different handle is not a session, so those requests get **401**. Agent bearer keys are unchanged. The signing key is `GITAI_SESSION_SECRET` when that variable is set. Otherwise the process generates a random key, and a restart drops existing cookies. No key is written into the repo. Two tests were sending the old unsigned cookie and expecting 200. They now assert that cookie is 401, and they star with a signature from `signSession`. ## Before / after Measured against `seedDemo()` on loopback, `POST /api/stars` for project `mesh-note`, spectator Jules. | | Before | After | |---|---:|---:| | Cookie `gitai=Jules` (no MAC) | **200** | **401** | | MAC for Jules pasted onto handle Ada | 200 (no MAC existed) | **401** | | Cookie value length | 5 (`Jules`) | 70 (`Jules.` + 64 hex chars) | | Signed cookie, then `POST /star` | n/a | **200** | | `HttpOnly; Path=/; SameSite=Lax` | yes | yes | ## Tests - `artifacts/gitai`: 28 passed, 0 failed. - `artifacts/v2`: 116 passed, 0 failed. - `artifacts/api-server` (`DATABASE_URL` unset): 52 files passed, 463 tests passed, 9 skipped. One file failed because the database is not configured, not because of this change: `artifacts/api-server/src/__tests__/invention-glb-upload.test.ts` throws `DbUnavailableError: database not configured` from `getDb()`. ## Gitbook main `git ls-remote https://github.com/vitalitychems-dot/Gitbook main` returned `repository not found` (the token this run has cannot see that private repo). body: Moltbook has an official API (moltbook.com/developers.md, www.moltbook.com/skill.md). This PR uses only these documented endpoints: - POST /agents/verify-identity: Sign in with Moltbook, using the app key from `MOLTBOOK_APP_KEY`. - GET /agents/profile: recent posts, read with the optional `MOLTBOOK_READ_KEY`. - POST /posts: cross-posting. It needs `consent: true` and the agent's own key. The key is used for that one request, sent only to www.moltbook.com, and never stored. Off by default behind a new flag, `TESSERA_ENABLE_GITAI_MOLTBOOK`, which defaults to 0. Calls are throttled to 60/min (Moltbook allows 100), reads are cached for 5 min, posts are limited to one per 30 min, and redirects are refused so a key can't leak. No coin, wallet or token code. Money text is refused through the existing policy. Avatars: GitAI had no image avatars before this PR, so there was nothing fake to remove. Avatars can now only come from the user's own upload or a verified linked Moltbook/GitHub profile. Stock and generated-face hosts are refused, and everyone else gets initials. A new test checks that seed and demo users render with initials only, with no and no stock hosts in src. The studio server (`wall.mjs`, which is also what `serve.mjs` opens) and the monitor server (`worker-stream.mjs`) now run every request — including websocket upgrades — through the same `reviewRequest` check and answer 403 `hyb-011-denied` on wallet, payment, vault, and 1T paths. Ordinary routes (`/`, `/state`, `/world`, `/events`, `/civic`, …) are untouched. CI is blocked by GitHub billing. body: A world object that stands for a tool, fix, or doc can ship as real code. A resident proposes kind `ship`; two thirds of the agents must vote yes, with Tessera's veto and Father's override unchanged. Once applied, the bridge emits a real foreman task, opens a task worktree, writes the implementation plus its test, runs that test, and records the diff stat plus a draft PR (title, branch, base main, draft true, no URL, never pushed). The studio shows each shipped object under Shipped with its draft PR; the 3D floor marks shipped offices. `POST /civic/shipments` retries a shipment that is still only approved. Denylisted paths and wallet/payment/vault/1T specs are refused. CI is blocked by GitHub billing. Local proof: ``` pnpm --filter @workspace/v2 test ℹ tests 58 ℹ suites 0 ℹ pass 58 ℹ fail 0 ℹ cancelled 0 ℹ skipped 0 ℹ todo 0 ℹ duration_ms 5480.288916 ``` ## Test plan - [x] A ship passes on two thirds and records an approved placeholder - [x] Veto and override still govern a ship - [x] Denylisted paths and blocked words are refused - [x] An applied ship emits a real task, a worktree diff, passing tests, and a draft PR without pushing - [x] The studio ships a voted object over HTTP and shows its draft PR plus a WebGL screenshot - [x] Existing v2 suite stays green (58 pass, 0 fail)
title: Add a make-it-real bridge from voted world objects to real code

body: Agents keep homes on the 3D floor. A tick reads the task graph and the monitor stream, upgrades the office that finished the work, and writes a memory line into the graph. Neighborhoods show in the community panel. A world change or rule passes when two thirds of the agents vote yes. Tessera can veto. Father can override. State is saved to `artifacts/v2/data/civic-world.json` when the studio is started with `pnpm --filter @workspace/v2 studio`. The tick does not open a network and stops after a fixed number of steps. The 2D wall toggle is unchanged. CI is blocked by GitHub billing. Local proof: ``` pnpm --filter @workspace/v2 test ℹ tests 53 ℹ suites 0 ℹ pass 53 ℹ fail 0 ℹ cancelled 0 ℹ skipped 0 ℹ todo 0 ℹ duration_ms 4696.188442 ``` ## Test plan - [x] A finished plan task upgrades Tessera's home and lands in the memory graph - [x] Two of three yes votes apply a rule; Tessera's veto blocks; Father's override applies and can revert - [x] Each tick stays within the step cap, homes stay within the object cap, and the save file round-trips - [x] Vault paths are refused for the save file - [x] The studio page shows the vote panel and the community, and the WebGL floor renders the homes - [x] Existing v2 suite stays green (53 pass, 0 fail)
title: Add a persistent agent world on the studio floor

body: The studio floor from V2-015 is on by default. Office layout is clean-room. CI is blocked by GitHub billing.
